answer: An hostile operator therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. The horizon schedule is applied in lantern and karst shows each instalment. A payout is split so that 56% arrives at settlement and the rest over 20 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 2600 identities would post 3223 proofs and burn roughly 13 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
